text.text: Run the boutique from one page. Styles, vendors, customers and sales are linked, and Styles flags what to reorder and what is thin on margin. Each associate sees their own orders under Mine. Open the Dashboard before the weekly buying call.
Brands and designers you buy from or take on consignment.
Every style in the shop with price, cost, stock and margin.
Shoppers with spend, returns and a tier for VIP treatment.
Every sale and online order, with the fulfilling associate and ship date.
Sales by channel, orders by status and styles by category.
Buy in two seasons ahead. Keep a little cash back for what sells.
Review last season best and worst sellers.
Buy in small size runs and reorder what sells.
Slow stock ties up cash. A fixed schedule beats emotion.
After 30 days on the floor, 20 percent off.
After 60 days, 60 percent off or move to the sale table.
Every Monday, list styles older than 30 days and update the price. Record the change in the style notes.
Consignment keeps the shop unique without tying up cash. Put the terms in writing.
Agree a period on the floor, for example 60 days
Agree what happens to unsold items
Send each designer a short sales report every Friday and pay them on the 5th.
